description.value: You force the target to delay their action until after the next creature in the initiative order takes their action unless the target makes a successful Will save. You must cast this spell before the results of the creature’s actions are determined. This may result in the creature’s action being invalid, such as attacking a target that has moved, in which case the action is wasted. If the target was casting a spell, they do not need to make a concentration check.
